name: player_destroy_save_game_state
description: Player::DestroySaveGameState removes the save state's HUD sensor track node, unlinks the save state from the global list, frees owned resources, and deletes the state.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x41fd20 calls Player::FreeAltWeaponTrailRuntimeStates, clears the root-node damage handler, removes and frees the root callback track node from g_HudUiMgrSensor_TrackList, unlinks the save state from the global save-state list, calls zUtil_SaveGameState::FreeOwnedResources, deletes the save state, and returns.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x41fd20 has no warnings or tags and shows the same track-list and save-state-list unlinking plus owned-resource cleanup.
The dependency frontier for 0x41fd20 has no visible source blockers after accepting zUtil_SaveGameState::FreeOwnedResources; the remaining direct callees and operator delete provider are accepted.
The native player_destroy_save_game_state_smoke verifies the HUD sensor track list and player save-state list are cleared after destroying a save state.
